# Registered domains test data may name, beyond the reserved names (any
# name whose public suffix ICANN does not manage, such as example.test) and
# the domains the shipped internal/semantics data already names.
#
# Never add a domain of a real organization seen in a live run. A test's
# subject is OWASP's, Utica University's or SUNY Poly's; any other party is
# a made-up name or a provider or standard listed here. Patterns use
# path.Match syntax.

# The test subjects and made-up names built on them.
*owasp*
utica*
notutica.edu
sunyit.edu
sunypoly.edu
